subject: Post-demo: SpectrumLink private connectivity and SDK auth — next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Asha Rao <asha@spectrumlink.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-04-27T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Post-demo: SpectrumLink private connectivity and SDK auth — next steps

Hi Asha —

Thanks again for joining the demo this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum: 

What we covered:
- Hosted API vs Dedicated vs Private deployment options that match your regulatory needs
- SDK onboarding flow, API key + mTLS option for private deployments
- VPC endpoint options (AWS PrivateLink) and IP allowlist patterns for customer-managed egress
- Structured output / tool-calling approach for pulling in your internal search/reranker

Open questions you flagged:
1) Do you want Redwood to terminate mTLS at our private endpoint or bring-your-own (BYO) cert via HSM?
2) Which subnets will be used for the VPC endpoint (we only need CIDR ranges / NACLs for firewall rules)?
3) Any egress inspection / DNS policies we should be aware of that could block kernel-level traffic?

Proposed next steps (can we confirm by EOD Wednesday?):
- You share network CIDRs + primary security contact (we can template the allowlist)
- We'll schedule a 60-min technical deep-dive with our infra engineer (Ben) for Thursday or Friday
- I’ll attach a short integration checklist and a suggested mutual action plan (MAP) so we have milestones

Attachments: integration checklist (edgeconnect-integration-checklist.pdf) and a topology sketch.

If this looks good I’ll send over two time options for the deep-dive.

Thanks,
Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0123

Attachment: edgeconnect-integration-checklist.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Asha Rao <asha@spectrumlink.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Philippe Moreau <philippe.moreau@spectrumlink.com>, SpectrumLink Solutions <solutions@spectrumlink.com>
Date: 2026-04-27T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: SpectrumLink private connectivity and SDK auth — next steps

Hi Marissa —

Really helpful demo — thanks. Quick answers below and a couple of asks from our infra/security team: 

Answers:
- We prefer Redwood to terminate mTLS at the private endpoint; we will rotate certs via our KMS.
- Primary subnets: 10.10.32.0/22 (prod), 10.10.36.0/22 (staging). We’ll provide VPC IDs and the security contact.
- DNS: we have outbound DNS interception for threat intel; any IPs should be resolvable via our forwarder.

Security asks (cc’ing Philippe who owns network):
- Philippe: can you confirm whether we need a separate NAT/egress path for tokenized payloads?
- We also need an initial SOC2 checklist and audit window for cert rotation.

Availability: Thursday 4/29 10:00–11:00 PDT or Friday 4/30 14:00–15:00 PDT for the deep-dive.

Thanks — I’ll attach our topology image and Philippe will follow up with a SOC2 contact.

Best,
Asha
Senior Product Manager, SpectrumLink
asha@spectrumlink.com | +1 646-555-0199

Attachment: spectrumlink-network-topology.png (image/png)

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Asha Rao <asha@spectrumlink.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-04-27T11:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: SpectrumLink private connectivity and SDK auth — next steps

Asha / Marissa —

Thanks for the quick replies. I’ll lead the technical deep-dive. Agenda I propose (60 mins):
- 0–10m: Introductions + architecture overview (SpectrumLink current infra)
- 10–25m: VPC endpoint options and reachability tests (PrivateLink vs VPC Peering)
- 25–40m: Auth options: API key + mTLS termination options, cert rotation cadence, KMS/HSM integration
- 40–50m: Structured output + reranker flow: where embeddings live, secure payload routing, latency SLAs
- 50–60m: Action items and MAP assignments

Prep requests (what we’ll need before the call):
- VPC IDs + CIDRs (prod & staging)
- Any proxy / outbound NAT IPs that will be used for egress
- Short list of sample payload sizes and percent of requests that will use reranker/embeddings

I’ll also bring a short demo of our SDK init flow and the mTLS handshake sequence so Philippe can validate. Marissa — can you lock Thursday 4/29 10:00 PDT? If Asha confirms, I’ll send the calendar invite with a Zoom link and a small pre-call checklist.

—Ben
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Asha Rao <asha@spectrumlink.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Philippe Moreau <philippe.moreau@spectrumlink.com>
Date: 2026-04-28T11:32:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: SpectrumLink private connectivity and SDK auth — next steps

Perfect — thanks everyone. Asha, locking Thursday 2026-04-29 10:00–11:00 PDT for the technical deep-dive (Zoom invite sent). 

Attached is the checklist I mentioned; it has the exact fields Ben needs and a suggested MAP with milestones up to POC (3 weeks). High-level owners: 
- Redwood: deep-dive + test account provisioning + sample SDK snippet (Ben)
- SpectrumLink: VPC IDs/CIDRs + SOC2 contact + cert rotation window (Asha / Philippe)

Small note on egress: if you have DNS interception, please ensure your forwarder allows outbound TLS handshakes to our endpoint hostnames (we’ll share an allowlist of hostnames and fallback IPs in the invite).

Looking forward — I added the Drive folder link with the checklist and topology.

Cheers,
Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
